message: Applications have a max of 0 snapshots until an admin raises it, in the snapshots modal or the workspace's Snapshots settings. Applications that already have snapshots get a max of that many.
bullet_points: API: creating a snapshot of an application with a max of 0 returns ERROR_MAX_SNAPSHOTS_IS_ZERO, and of an application at its max whose snapshots are all protected returns ERROR_MAX_SNAPSHOTS_FULL_OF_PROTECTED. Pass raise_max_snapshots to raise the max by one first.
API: snapshots are created protected. Pass protected false to let a later snapshot replace it once the application is at its max.
